# Angela Potenza

> Angela Potenza — Copywriter & UX Designer. Personal link-in-bio page. Angela
> creates content and UX strategies that attract potential clients, raise a
> product's perceived value and usability, and strengthen the bond between brands
> and their consumers. The page is available in Spanish, English and Portuguese.
